title: Alfredo Grilled Chicken
instructions: Chop up the chicken breast and season it with chilli powder, salt, parsley, paprika, garlic powder, and italian herbs.
Fry it over some butter until golden, then add more butter and set aside.
Chop up some onion. Fry it in the same pan until translucent.
Add garlic and sauce spice mix and bloom it for a bit.
Add chopped tomatoes, cook for a few minutes.
Add heavy cream, milk, cheese and fresh cheese. Optionally add a splash of pasta water.
